description: Peanut butter oatmeal chocolate chunk breakfast cookies The perfect grab and go breakfast or snack! These are packed full of flavor and nutrient dense! Try it and tag me! d’EATS  -1 large bananas -1/2 cup natural nut butter (I used peanut butter) -1/3 cup maple syrup  -1 egg -1 tsp vanilla extract  -1 cup oat flour -1 & 1/4 cup rolled oats -1 tsp cinnamon  -1 tsp baking soda -1/2 cup chocolate chips  How to: Start by preheating your oven to 350F In a large bowl add your bananas and mash until smooth. Add in your maple syrup and nut butter and mix well. Add in your egg and vanilla and stir until smooth.  Add in all your dry ingredients and mix until incorporated. Allow batter to sit for 5 minutes so the oats can absorb some of the liquid.  Scoop cookie onto a lined baking sheet using a 1” cookie sheet.  Bake on 350F for 10-12 minutes and enjoy! *store on the counter for 4 days or in the refrigerator for 7 days*  #recipe #foryoupage #fyp #recipes #dessert #cookies #cookie #breakfast
transcript: Peanut butter oatmeal chocolate chunk breakfast cookies are the perfect recipe to save and make if you're looking for a quick easy and delicious breakfast to take with you on the go. These breakfast cookies are made with a few simple ingredients you probably already have on hand so do yourself a favor and save this recipe now so you have it to make for later. You're going to start by taking a large ripe banana and adding it to a bowl and mashing it until it is completely smooth. Once your banana is mashed up add your creamy peanut butter and maple syrup and mix until combined. Add in your egg and vanilla extract and mix again. Once all your wet ingredients are incorporated add in your dry ingredients and fold until all is mixed together. This part is optional but I love to add in chocolate chips. Once your batter is made, scoop your cookies onto a lined baking sheet and place them in the oven. Once they're baked, they are ready to be enjoyed.
